notes.text: Your application has two trees. This release shows you the other one.
Accessibility — a third tree mode with the announced name and role, tab-order overlay, WCAG contrast, findings in Problems.
Accessibility over MCP — get_tab_order, plus the new mode in get_tree and the new category in get_problems.
Call counts per MCP tool — in the MCP Server tab.
MCP settings in one place — the ⚙ card. The tab is there while the endpoint listens.
UI improvements — draggable tree columns, drawn column edges, ellipsized Problems rows.
Element screenshots — no longer twice-scaled on a scaled display.
